## Connect before publishing
Webhook Header Auth: Authorization = Bearer YOUR_SERVER_SECRET.
Workflow Settings: actual published MCP URL; model fixed to gemini-3.5-flash-lite.
All 3 MCP Clients: same MCP header credential.
All 3 Model HTTP Requests: saved Google Gemini(PaLM) Api credential.
No database credential is used here. Website approval remains in Python.
No server-side deduplication: keep N8N_IDEMPOTENT=false.

## Match → write → independently review
3 generation calls, 3 explicit MCP calls, 1 query embedding. No recursive supervisor or hidden memory. Strict JSON output schemas and actual provider usage are checked. The critic may correct the body in its single pass. The counted final letter is assembled once, then never rewritten.
This fixed pipeline replaces the classroom autonomous agent loop; it does not claim exact course-node compliance or guaranteed ten-second latency.
